title: Towards a Cloud Fog Edge System for Smart Building
abstract: arXiv:2610.01647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this article, we present our vision and recent advancements toward creating a decentralized system capable of learning from real-time data within buildings to support sustainable and privacy-preserving smart environments. Our approach promotes the concept of the building itself as the data center, aligning with the principles of edge computing to safeguard confidentiality and reduce reliance on external cloud infrastructure. This is particularly valuable in humanitarian contexts, where data sovereignty, energy efficiency, and infrastructure constraints are critical. We detail a lightweight, "Kubernetes-like" orchestration framework for deploying AI services within such environments and demonstrate our progress in implementing AI algorithms on low-power, cost-effective microcontrollers such as those in the Arduino ecosystem. translated_title: 迈向面向智能建筑的云-雾-边系统
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们展示了构建一个能够从建筑物内实时数据中学习的去中心化系统的愿景与最新进展，旨在支持可持续且保护隐私的智能环境。我们的方法倡导“建筑物本身即数据中心”的理念，遵循边缘计算原则，以保障数据机密性并减少对外部云基础设施的依赖。这在人道主义背景下尤其具有价值，因为数据主权、能源效率和基础设施限制在这些场景中至关重要。我们详细介绍了一个轻量级的、类Kubernetes的编排框架，用于在此类环境中部署AI服务，并展示了我们在Arduino生态系统等低功耗、低成本微控制器上实现AI算法方面的进展。通过使传感器或微控制器能够直接进行原位学习，我们的工作旨在将智能服务
tldr: 该论文提出将建筑物本身作为数据中心的云-雾-边去中心化系统，通过轻量级类Kubernetes编排框架在低功耗微控制器上实现原位AI学习，从而支持可持续且保护隐私的智能建筑环境。
en_tdlr: This paper envisions a decentralized cloud-fog-edge system where the building itself serves as the data center, enabling in-situ AI learning on low-power microcontrollers through a lightweight Kubernetes-like orchestration framework to support sustainable and privacy-preserving smart buildings.
